name: Profile Management (PM)
description: PM Access Application (Permohonan Akses): a non-federal agency user applies for Company Profile (CP) and/or Market Research (MR) access; one application (AA, e.g. AP200204000000835) runs two status tracks in PM_WORKFLOW_STATUS. 75030 Cancelled by System is set by the scheduler (PmAccessApplJob, rule PMACT days): simulate it (npm run qa -- simulate). PM user/role/group administration (claude-skills pm-admin) is test SETUP, not a status flow: it changes shared master data, so it is not automated here.

PM-001.title: Agency user submits an Access Application for Company Profile access
PM-001.source: portlet pmAccessApplication / AccessApplSO (claude-skills note) → support/modules/pm/access.ts (built from the SIT screens 2026-11-24)
PM-001.instructions: Portlet pmAccessApplication: tick Company Profile, attach documents, submit. One pending application per IC (ERROR_776045).

db.evidence: claude-skills memory reference-pm-access-application-flow (FL fullfilment and PM.zip) + SIT DB 2026-11-23: PM_WORKFLOW_STATUS CP/MR on PM_ACCESS_APPL (statuses 75000/75005/75010/75015/75020/75030 all in use). No document of ours yet
